name: codedp-bench-repo-patch-cpt
description:
CodeDP Repo-Patch Benchmark (CPT-friendly)
	

Repository-level code completion benchmark for evaluating continual pre-training (CPT) models. 55 tasks from 12 real-world repositories, each requiring the model to generate a function body given file-level context.

	
		
		Prompt Format
	

The prompt field contains the file context up to the target function's signature and docstring (truncated at the original # TODO: Implement this function marker). This format is directly usable by… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/melihcatal/codedp-bench-repo-patch-cpt.
evaluation_method: pass@k / exact_match and functional correctness (unit test / compile/run-based evaluation where available)
reputation: A small, targeted repo-level code-completion benchmark used for evaluating continual pre-training methods; useful for niche research on repo-context generation but not a broad community standard.
